sections.instruction: [Provide the purpose of the Functional Requirements Definition Document. This document should be tailored to fit a particular project’s needs.]
sections.boilerplate: The Functional Requirements Definition documents and tracks the necessary information required to effectively define business and functional requirements. The Functional Requirements Definition document is created during the Planning Phase of the project. Its intended audience isthe project manager, project team, project sponsor, client/user, and any stakeholder whose input/approval into the requirements definitions process is needed.
